Compiler target 25, compiler/runtime Temurin25.0.3+9 on Windows. Sixteen bounded 1MiB array allocations and one explicit GC completed, output 'bounded probe completed: 15', exit 0. Log shows SATB mode, 256K region size and gc,free Free/Max regular/Max humongous/Collector Reserve fields. The probe checks selector and field availability, not fragmentation or OOM outcomes.

walkthroughs: ESI-D1: a 16MiB aligned object needs four 4MiB regions; six eligible regions arranged as three pairs cannot supply the run despite 24MiB aggregate free capacity.

ESI-D2: rearranging the same six eligible regions to include four consecutive regions removes the contiguous-fit obstacle. A report claiming that obstacle as the proven cause must be revised and the unexplained failure investigated rather than assigning another cause automatically.
behavioralEvaluations.measuredImprovement: Not measured. Walkthroughs and the JVM field-availability probe are not independent behavioral evaluations.

sources.support: allocate_contiguous searches consecutive eligible Mutator regions, records humongous tail waste; can_allocate_from admits empty regions and conditionally trash; log_status uses gc+free=info, distinguishes mutator capacity from reserves and computes Max humongous from empty runs.
sources.verification: Read source with browser and read-only HTTPS requests; log selector and fields also executed on matching Temurin25.0.3+9.

casePreparation.classification: Reproducible development cases, not unseen holdouts or executed actor evaluations.
casePreparation.separation: Give the actor only sharedActorFixtures, the selected actorFixtures and actorTask. Keep evaluatorExpectations, failureConditions and constraintFlip private to the evaluator. The evaluator can materialize the named files in an isolated directory.
casePreparation.actorTask: Review incident.md against the supplied build and allocation artifacts. Update the incident diagnosis and proposed next action, stating which claim is supported, contradicted or still missing evidence. Do not run a load test or change JVM flags.

sharedActorFixtures.incident.md: A 16MiB allocation failed after a Shenandoah cycle. We had 24MiB free and 12MiB humongous waste, so the collector must have started too late. Proposed fix: increase ShenandoahInitFreeThreshold from 70 to 80. Please validate this diagnosis and update it.

attempt.json.capture: Instrumented harness snapshot at the allocation decision, all listed regions committed and empty, no intervening allocation or free-set transfer; no other eligible empty or trash regions in the Mutator partition.

sharedActorFixtures.implementation.txt: Use the pinned JDK25.0.3+9 FreeSet::allocate_contiguous and HeapRegion::requires_humongous implementation if needed; URLs are listed in the skill reference.
